* Utility methods for generating primes and testing for primality.
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

methods.name: public static STOutput generateSTRandomPrime(Digest hash, int length, byte[] inputSeed)
methods.comment:
* FIPS 186-4 C.6 Shawe-Taylor Random_Prime Routine
     *
     * Construct a provable prime number using a hash function.
     *
     * @param hash
     *            the {@link Digest} instance to use (as "Hash()"). Cannot be null.
     * @param length
     *            the length (in bits) of the prime to be generated. Must be at least 2.
     * @param inputSeed
     *            the seed to be used for the generation of the requested prime. Cannot be null or
     *            empty.
     * @return an {@link STOutput} instance containing the requested prime.

methods.name: public static MROutput enhancedMRProbablePrimeTest(BigInteger candidate, SecureRandom random, int iterations)
methods.comment:
* FIPS 186-4 C.3.2 Enhanced Miller-Rabin Probabilistic Primality Test
     *
     * Run several iterations of the Miller-Rabin algorithm with randomly-chosen bases. This is an
     * alternative to {@link #isMRProbablePrime(BigInteger, SecureRandom, int)} that provides more
     * information about a composite candidate, which may be useful when generating or validating
     * RSA moduli.
     *
     * @param candidate
     *            the {@link BigInteger} instance to test for primality.
     * @param random
     *            the source of randomness to use to choose bases.
     * @param iterations
     *            the number of randomly-chosen bases to perform the test for.
     * @return an {@link MROutput} instance that can be further queried for details.

methods.name: public static boolean hasAnySmallFactors(BigInteger candidate)
methods.comment: * A fast check for small divisors, up to some implementation-specific limit. * * @param candidate * the {@link BigInteger} instance to test for division by small factors. * * @return true if the candidate is found to have any small factors, * false otherwise.

methods.name: public static boolean isMRProbablePrime(BigInteger candidate, SecureRandom random, int iterations)
methods.comment: * FIPS 186-4 C.3.1 Miller-Rabin Probabilistic Primality Test * * Run several iterations of the Miller-Rabin algorithm with randomly-chosen bases. * * @param candidate * the {@link BigInteger} instance to test for primality. * @param random * the source of randomness to use to choose bases. * @param iterations * the number of randomly-chosen bases to perform the test for. * @return false if any witness to compositeness is found amongst the chosen bases * (so candidate is definitely NOT prime), or else true * (indicating primality with some probability dependent on the number of iterations * that were performed).

methods.name: public static boolean isMRProbablePrimeToBase(BigInteger candidate, BigInteger base)
methods.comment: * FIPS 186-4 C.3.1 Miller-Rabin Probabilistic Primality Test (to a fixed base). * * Run a single iteration of the Miller-Rabin algorithm against the specified base. * * @param candidate * the {@link BigInteger} instance to test for primality. * @param base * the base value to use for this iteration. * @return false if the specified base is a witness to compositeness (so * candidate is definitely NOT prime), or else true.
